verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe saving a logged-in profile once and reusing it to start future browsers already authenticated, plus a related 2FA-continuation flow that persists session state across runs, directly matching the story. Community reports corroborate a similar pattern (connecting to a local logged-in browser profile to skip login for LinkedIn automation), though this is the local-profile variant, not the cloud 'save profile' feature. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of the cloud profile-save/reuse workflow, and detail on profile scope/expiry/security handling beyond docs.
